The browser calls the API Gateway URL from config.js; CORS only allows the CloudFront origin.
Staff accepts the complaint. This request is already served by the new version; users did not notice the release.
Admin opens the dashboard (same app, admin view from the JWT role) and picks a staff member.
URL valid 300 s for uploads/<key>. The file goes straight to S3 and never passes through the containers.
ALB forwards to a healthy auth task in AZ-a or AZ-b.

bcrypt compare against auth.users; returns a JWT (HS256, 1 h) carrying sub and role=STUDENT.
Complaint row + first status-history row; returns 201 with reference CMP-2026-000123.

GET /api/notifications and PATCH /api/notifications/{id}/read go from API Gateway straight to this Lambda (Lambda proxy integration). Drawn as a documented route so the simulator keeps POST /api/complaints on the VPC Link -> ALB path.
SELECT from notification.notifications WHERE user_id = sub.
SendMessage to SQS. The API has already answered the user; notification work is asynchronous.
Batch of up to 10, no batching window; failed records are reported individually and retried, then sent to the DLQ after 3 tries.
After 3 failed receives a message is moved to the DLQ; ccms-dlq-not-empty alarm fires.
GET /internal/users/{id} through the internal ALB to the Auth Service (never exposed on API Gateway).
INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (event_id, user_id) DO NOTHING, so a retried message never creates duplicates.
SES SendEmail from the verified sender (skipped if no sender is configured; in-app still works).
Email delivered to the student's inbox.

data.flowExplanation: Private tasks and Lambdas reach ECR API, SQS, SES, Secrets Manager and X-Ray through the NAT Gateway (port 443 only).
NAT Gateway sends outbound traffic to the internet through the Internet Gateway.
ECR image layers (stored in S3) are pulled through the free S3 gateway endpoint, not the NAT.
Lambdas read the DB and JWT secrets once per cold start.
Active tracing: each invocation sends a trace segment.
Active tracing on the notification API Lambda.
If the new tasks keep failing, the ECS deployment circuit breaker rolls back to the previous revision automatically.
ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible >= 1 -> ccms-dlq-not-empty.
Budget alert email at 80% of the forecast spend.
A teammate reviews the pull request; the change only touches services/complaint-service/**.
CodePipeline V2 trigger with file-path filter services/complaint-service/** through the ccms-github connection; auth-service is not rebuilt.
npm ci, npm audit --audit-level=high (fails the build on high/critical), npm test --if-present, docker build.
data.flowAction: 37. [DEVELOPER] Build stage: audit, test, docker build

data.flowExplanation: ECR scans the image on push. CodeBuild writes imagedefinitions.json for the deploy stage.
Registers a new task-definition revision with the :<git-sha> image and updates the complaint-service.
auth-service uses the same Source -> Build -> Deploy path when services/auth-service/** changes.
CloudTrail event history shows who started the pipeline and the UpdateService call.
scripts/aws-up.sh runs the ccms-migrate task once after terraform apply (already-migrated databases are skipped).
psql_url comes from Secrets Manager, never from Git.
Creates the auth, complaint and notification schemas and seed data from db/init.sql.
API Gateway forwards ANY /api/{proxy+} over the VPC Link (ENIs in both private app subnets) to the internal ALB; sg-vpclink may only reach sg-alb on port 80.
AUTH_SERVICE_URL points at the internal ALB, whose /internal/users/* rule forwards to the Auth Service; /internal/* is never routed by API Gateway. Confirms the target is an active STAFF user.

phases.summary: Log in, upload photo, submit complaint, COMPLAINT_SUBMITTED email, read in-app notifications
Assign staff (staff checked through the internal ALB), COMPLAINT_ASSIGNED email to staff and student
Merge, CodePipeline build/audit, push to ECR, ECS rolling update with circuit breaker, alarm check
Accept and resolve on the new version, STATUS_CHANGED emails
